أُبَاتِرٌ (assumed tropical:) Short; (M, K;) as though cut off from completion. (M.) ―
-b2- See also أَبْتَرُ. ―
-b3- Also (assumed tropical:) A man who cuts, or severs, the ties, or bonds, of his relationship; who disunites himself from his relations; (S, M, K;) as also ↓ بَاتِرٌ ; (A:) or quick to cut, or sever, the ties, or bonds, between him and his friend. (IAar.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
